technical-summary: Preserve the RSC12 chunked-file-v1 identity format when producing a fresh manifest cache index and when checking authenticated stored bytes. Factor the existing digest grammar into shared chunk accumulation helpers and expose a bytes-based path for already-read manifest bytes; keep raw SHA-256 as the EngineStart execution integrity value. A regression test compares path and in-memory identities and resolves a serialized index through the named-cache reader. The focused stored-cache, serving, stored-replay, native-projection and v3-wire tests pass.
user-summary-candidate: Fixed a stored-manifest cache digest mismatch while keeping the existing index format, and verified the focused serving and replay checks.
